From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Northbridge: data handling & training opt-out — need legal/compliance language

Marissa — here’s approved language and operational commitments we can provide to Northbridge. Legal has reviewed and is comfortable with the wording below plus the DPA addendum. Please send this as-is to the customer.

1) Customer confirmation wording (approved):
"Redwood Inference confirms that when Northbridge Analytics requests and activates the training-opt-out setting for its account, Redwood will not use Northbridge customer content (including prompts, inputs, outputs, embeddings, and associated metadata) to train, fine-tune, or otherwise improve Redwood model weights or internal training/evaluation corpora. Aggregated telemetry that includes identifiable Northbridge identifiers will be excluded from model training. This technical opt-out is applied at the tenant/account level and enforced by our serving/runtime configuration and deployment controls."

2) Operational notes (defaults & process):
- Retention: Request/usage logs and operational traces are retained 180 days by default. We can provision a 90-day retention policy for Northbridge at account onboarding; please note billing records (invoice history) are retained for 7 years for compliance.
- Purge: On-demand purge of customer content (prompts, responses, embeddings) is available; standard SLA for purge and confirmation is 5 business days once the request is validated by our team.
- Residency: Customer content at rest will be stored in the requested us-east-1 region. We do not replicate customer content to other regions for training. Operational telemetry may traverse other regions for routing but is scrubbed of customer identifiers prior to any aggregation.
- Audit evidence: We will provide a SOC 2 Type II attestation link and a signed DPA addendum that references the training-opt-out. We can also provide a one-off access log extract for audit purposes under NDA.

3) Limitations/notes:
- The opt-out prevents Redwood from using customer content to train Redwood-managed public or internal models. It does not restrict Northbridge from exporting logs/embeddings for their own model training.
- Aggregated non-identifiable telemetry used for platform health may be retained; anything that could identify Northbridge is excluded from training per the above.

Attachments: opt_out_confirmation.txt (text) — includes the short paragraph and signature block for procurement.

If that looks good I’ll ask Legal to countersign the DPA addendum and Marissa can send both items to procurement.

—Dylan
Security & Trust (Redwood Inference)
